Chicago: A Fishing Charter on Lake Michigan

Trade time in the city for a fishing charter from Chicago. Head onto Lake Michigan and spend a day with a rod over open water.

About this water

The fishery source record for Lake Michigan / Chicago, United States, identifies Chinook salmon and Burbot.

A Lake Michigan charter from Chicago should start with clear city transport and marina instructions. Ask the captain to name the actual target; a Chinook record and a burbot record do not describe one interchangeable trip. Confirm the departure, boarding time and tackle aboard. Compare the fishing duration after transfers and boat travel. The source material does not establish a catch rate, a charter's current availability or its equipment inventory.
